runbook.auth_strategy: No auth required for demo target. In production, navigate to /login → enter vaulted credentials → wait for dashboard redirect.
runbook.global_navigation_notes: All test cases start from the wire transfer page at base_url. The mock app supports ?chaos_mode=true to simulate broken selectors.

test_cases.title: Standard Wire Transfer — Valid Domestic
raw_steps: Navigate to the wire transfer page
test_cases.expected_result: Confirmation page shows reference 'TXN-MOCK-001' with status 'submitted'

test_cases.title: Wire Transfer — Minimum Amount $1
raw_steps: Navigate to the wire transfer page
test_cases.expected_result: Confirmation page shows reference with status 'submitted'

test_cases.title: Wire Transfer — Large Amount $1,000,000
raw_steps: Navigate to the wire transfer page
test_cases.expected_result: Confirmation page shows reference with status 'submitted'

test_cases.title: Wire Transfer — PII Redaction Verified
raw_steps: Navigate to the wire transfer page
Verify that SSN was redacted to {{REDACTED_SSN_*}} in audit log before submission
test_cases.expected_result: Transfer succeeds AND audit_trail.jsonl contains redacted tokens, NOT raw SSN

test_cases.title: Wire Transfer — Credit Card in Notes Field Redacted
raw_steps: Navigate to the wire transfer page
test_cases.expected_result: Transfer succeeds with credit card data redacted from all logs

test_cases.title: Wire Transfer — Email in Account Notes Redacted
raw_steps: Navigate to the wire transfer page
test_cases.expected_result: Transfer succeeds with email addresses redacted from all logs

test_cases.title: Wire Transfer — Form Field Validation (Empty Amount)
raw_steps: Navigate to the wire transfer page

test_cases.title: Wire Transfer — Page Load Performance
raw_steps: Navigate to the wire transfer page

test_cases.title: Wire Transfer — Self-Healing: Submit Button Renamed (Chaos Mode)
raw_steps: Navigate to the wire transfer page with chaos_mode=true
test_cases.expected_result: Self-healing agent detects renamed button (#btn-legacy-v2-obfuscated-99), auto-patches selector, and completes transfer successfully
test_cases.preconditions: chaos_mode=true must be enabled on the target app

test_cases.title: Wire Transfer — Self-Healing: Multiple Selector Mutations
raw_steps: Navigate to the wire transfer page with chaos_mode=true
test_cases.expected_result: Self-healing agent recovers from the selector mutation and completes transfer with healing diff logged in audit trail
test_cases.preconditions: chaos_mode=true must be enabled on the target app

test_cases.title: Wire Transfer — Application Bug: Incorrect Fee Calculation
raw_steps: Navigate to the wire transfer page
Verify that the transfer fee is calculated as 0.5% of amount ($250)
test_cases.preconditions: This test is EXPECTED TO FAIL — the mock app does not implement fee calculation, exposing a genuine application defect
